findings: All terms are defined within a shore-based model lesson; no sailing knowledge or video is required.
Steady concerns even strength, horizontal spatial alignment, leeward the side away from wind and gusts short bursts; these labels cannot be swapped.
Indirect observation through thread movement is explicitly separated from a complete account of real-water forces.
Unused continuous, instruments, pressure, slack and transparent were checked against every slot, including continuous versus steady at gap3.

questionAudits.finding: fastened at selected points解释attached固定在表面。slack为松弛、steady为稳定，transparent透明不说明连接；其他候选不构成该过去分词连接关系。
movement of air across sail直接定义airflow气流。pressure为压强不等于空气运动，direction只方向、instruments为仪器，其他名词不指该流动过程。
even strength rather than changing解释steady稳定的。continuous仅不断不保证强度均匀，transparent透明、slack松弛、horizontal水平、leeward背风均不定义强度稳定。
parallel to table而非垂下定义horizontal水平。steady表稳定不表角度，slack松弛不等于平行；leeward是背风侧，transparent透明不表空间方向。
moving rapidly irregularly定义flutter飘动。observe观察以学习者为主体，非线条自身动作；其他词不作began to后的这种快速摆动动词。
before describing及looking at both sides要求observe观察。flutter指飘动不能以both sides为观察宾语；其余候选非该查看动作原形动词。
side facing away from wind直接定义leeward背风侧。direction为方向，horizontal水平不指背风，pressure压强与steady稳定不定义相对风的一侧。
brief bursts stronger wind定义gusts阵风。instruments仪器、airflow泛指流动、pressure压强均非复数短促强风；其他词词性或含义不符。
in which thread pointed要求direction指向。pressure为压强，airflow空气流不自然作线头指向in which结构，instruments为器具；其他词非该方向名词。
through effect on small object说明indirectly间接显示。其余候选没有表示借助可见后果认识不可见气流的方式副词；continuous等形容词不能直接修饰revealed。

findings: The simplified cycle explicitly defines evaporation as liquid-to-gas and condensation as gas-to-liquid; each gap tests the supplied relation.
Compressor and thermostat have distinct pressure versus control functions. Insulation limits wall heat transfer; ventilation helps remove exterior heat.
The explanation does not claim all appliances have one detailed design or that insulation prevents every transfer.
Unused efficient, moderately, releases, sealed and uniform were checked against every grammar/meaning slot.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/full-passage unique-key review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: space inside cabinet直接定义interior内部。insulation为隔热层、ventilation通风、compressor压缩机、thermostat温控器都不是柜内空间本身。
repeatedly travelling closed system为circulates循环。releases释放需合适宾语，evaporates蒸发和condenses凝结是局部相变非整个管路周回；其他项非该单数主语动词。
liquid into gas定义evaporates蒸发。condenses方向相反，circulates循环不保证相变，releases需宾语而非into gas表示自己变气；其他词不作该相变谓语。
heat from cabinet into working fluid为absorbed吸收。sealed为密封不是热被接收，releases为主动单数词形不能作is后被动，其他候选非该过去分词。
increasing gas pressure定义compressor压缩机。thermostat监测控制开停，不是压气部件；interior空间、insulation隔热层、ventilation通风均非该机械。
gas back into liquid定义condenses凝结。evaporates是反向蒸发、circulates泛循环、releases为放出不是自身变液；其他词词性不合。
walls protective layer slows heat transfer定义insulation隔热。ventilation空气流通反而非墙内阻热层，interior为空间，thermostat控制器、compressor机械均非此材料层。
monitors condition、controls when runs according setting定义thermostat温控器。compressor执行压缩非监测设定装置；temperature是被监测量而非控制装置；其他候选非该器件。
measure how hot cold直接定义temperature温度。interior空间，ventilation空气流动，insulation隔热材料均非冷热程度量；其他候选不符合定义。
space and air movement allow heat away定义ventilation通风。insulation阻热与外侧散热需求不同，interior为柜内空间；其他名词非外部空气交换条件。

findings: The cell layout is two columns of three possible positions, and tactile raised patterns are distinguished from a printed introductory diagram.
Arrangement is within-cell spatial position; sequence is the ordered progression across cells; context affects interpretation in a specified code.
The text avoids treating introductory alphabet patterns as every braille convention or claiming one afternoon creates fluency.
Unused adjacent, fluent, identical, isolated and rotated were checked across all ten gaps. No unseen braille image is needed to answer.

possible dot positions为单元内各可能点位。columns只有两列但点位六个，abbreviations缩写、fingertips指尖均不是点可占的格位；其他候选不合定义。

sensitive ends fingers直接定义fingertips指尖。positions位置、columns列、abbreviations缩写是符号或抽象位置，不是身体触摸部位；其他项含义不符。
read through touch rather than ink sight直接定义tactile触觉的。fluent流利、identical相同、adjacent邻接、isolated独立都不说明感知通道。
same number but different places说明arrangement排列重要。sequence后文指定跨单元的先后，这里为一格内部空间排布；context周边解释条件不是点位布局，其他名词不合。
surrounding signs and writing system解释context语境。arrangement指格内点位布局，sequence只是先后而非完整解释环境；其他候选不命名所述上下文条件。
shortened forms representing words letters定义abbreviations缩略。columns列、positions点位、fingertips指尖都不是简写形式，sequence为顺序，其他词词性不合。
ordered series one cell next定义sequence序列。arrangement可泛布局但这里强调先后顺序且第6空定义格内布局；context周边语境不等于ordered series；其他名词不指序列。
approved material into braille version指transcribe转写。rotated/embossed是过去式不能接staff此处一般现在及into version的转写义，其他项非适合的动词原形。

findings: The text is explicitly a simplified fictional model; it does not state a universal rule for all ant species or every route choice.
Colony versus individual and route versus detour have separate definitions; the latter also respects the once-only rule.
Reinforcement adds signal, evaporation removes material, and a barrier introduces a new path condition.

Unused dispersed, decay, departures, randomly and traces were checked against all slots. The close unused concentrated was replaced before publication so strengthened versus dispersed has an explicit directional contrast.

questionAudits.finding: group ants living together定义colony蚁群。individual是单体非群体，departures离开、traces痕迹均非共同生活群落，其他名词不合。
one route was shorter指两路径之一。detour为绕行但此时未有障碍绕路，scent气味、barrier障碍、decay衰减均不是最初路径名。
an odour others detect定义scent气味。traces为复数不能接a，chemical作物质名也非此处嗅觉线索定义；route路径、barrier障碍不指气味。
carried by substances rather than spoken drawing定义chemical化学信号。dispersed是分散不说明信号媒介，shorter长度、individual个体均不定义物质传递的性质。
earlier return before long-branch ants锁定shorter较短。dispersed分散、individual单独、chemical化学均不表示路径更短；其他候选词性不合。
strengthening rather than weakening定义reinforced加强。evaporated蒸发为损失并不增强，dispersed是分散，与strengthening signal的增强方向不符；其余非合适过去式。
into the air及material loss定义evaporated挥发。reinforced强化与损失相反，decay原形词形不合且不等于进入空气，其他项不作该过去时过程。
obstruction cannot pass directly定义barrier障碍。detour是绕行路径，route普通路径、scent气味、colony蚁群都不是堵住熟路的障碍物。
different way around it、diversion定义detour绕路。route泛路径但第2空占用且此处专指偏离原线绕障；barrier为物体、departures复数不接a，其他项无此专义。
one organism acting locally定义individual单个的。chemical只表化学性质、dispersed分散、shorter较短均不表达一只而非群体；其他候选不适合an后定语。

findings: Proxy measurement and reconstructed target are distinct; annual ring formation is an explicitly given condition of this exercise, not asserted for every tree.
Chronology assigns years, calibration relates ring properties to known values, correlation describes co-variation and confounding concerns alternative influences.
Replicate repeats within an appropriate sample design; extrapolate extends beyond the tested range. The explanations do not conflate them.
Unused dormant, indices, lagged, residual and synchronous were tested against every slot; no actual climate dataset or calibration success is claimed.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/full-passage unique-key review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: indirect indicator infer unrecorded variable直接定义proxy代用指标。indices泛指标为复数且不接a，chronology为时序，calibration为校准，correlation为相关，均非所定义间接替代物。
once each year直接定义annual年度的。synchronous为同步、lagged为滞后、dormant为休眠、residual为残余，均不指一年一次的形成周期。
ordered sequence tied years定义chronology年代序列。calibration为关系标定、correlation为共变，proxy代用指标，variability变异性，均不命名具体历年排列。
relating ring property known observations定义calibration校准。correlation只是其后报告的相关关系，chronology是已建立时序；其他名词不指用已知观测标定关系的过程。
statistical及how two varied together定义correlation相关。calibration是标定过程不直接等于共同变化指标，variability是单个量变化程度，chronology为时间排序，均非此关系名。
effect mixed another undistinguished influence定义confounded混杂。lagged为滞后、synchronous同步、dormant休眠、residual残留都不表示混入未区分因素；其他候选词形或含义不符。
repeating analysis additional samples明确定义replicate重复验证。extrapolate是延伸到未试范围，非再取适当样本重复；其余候选不作to后的该原形动作。
beyond range tested直接定义extrapolate外推。replicate重复不等于跨范围延伸，其他词非该动作原形；不能把证据范围外延伸说成已有重复。
changes time rather perfect constancy定义variability变异。correlation两量共变、chronology序列、calibration标定、proxy代用物均不直接指时间变化性质。
with instruments直接解释instrumentally通过仪器地。其余候选无表示仪器直接测量方式的副词；annual等形容词不能修饰measured，且与重建来源区别不符。

findings: The exercise is fictional language training, not a claim about one jurisdiction’s legal duties.
Witness and interpreter are different sources. Consecutive describes turn timing, register social style and pragmatic situation-dependent function.
Omission changes commitment, ambiguity remains an issue for clarification, and attribution preserves who contributed each statement.

Unused contemporaneous, deference, paraphrase, sequentially and visibility were checked against all gaps; verbatim is explicitly a source-language transcript, not an impossible demand for identical words across languages.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/full-passage unique-key review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: person carries speech between languages定义interpreter口译员。witness为事件叙述者，与该角色明确不同；attribution归属、paraphrase释述、visibility可见性非这个人。
speaker completes segment then translation rather at once定义consecutive交替传译。contemporaneous表同时期不表示分段后译，explicit明确、pragmatic语用、verbatim逐字均不是这种轮次形式名称。
left out qualification、removed original part定义omission遗漏。paraphrase为换述通常仍传意，attribution归属、ambiguity歧义、deference敬让不等于删去限定语。
utterance does in situation rather dictionary alone定义pragmatic语用。explicit明确、contemporaneous同一时期、consecutive交替、verbatim逐字均不表示语境中的行为功能。
level style language relationship定义register语域。deference只是尊让态度不是全部语言层级风格，paraphrase换述、ambiguity歧义、visibility可见性均非该定义。
as though speaker stated directly说明make explicit明说。verbatim逐字不意味着把未确定理解变成明说，pragmatic为语用不表表达显性；其他词不作此对应directly stated的补语。
possibility more one meaning直接定义ambiguity歧义。omission遗漏不等于多个释义，paraphrase换述、attribution归属、deference敬让均非多义可能性。
identifying who said what定义attribution归属。register语域、visibility可见性、paraphrase释述均不直接标明说话人；ambiguity多义与清晰说话归属不同。
who described an event且与language professional分开，witness证人。interpreter为语言转换者已占第1空且此句正区分，其他候选不命名这一事件陈述人。
word for word instead summary定义verbatim逐字。sequentially依次只说次序不保证不改词，contemporaneous形容同时期而不表逐字方式；其他候选没有此准确复制原话的义。

findings: Negative and emulsion are defined as film element and coated layer. Physical deterioration is not equated with a scanner fault.
The costume photograph is explicitly a reference, not a duplicate film; its support is limited to relevant decisions.
Saturation, contrast and original exposure are separately defined. Selective treatment does not claim one universal increase restores authenticity.
Splice records material history; conjecture labels unsupported reconstruction. Unused chromatic, composite, duplicate, frame and uniformity were checked against all slots.

questionAudits.finding: first sentence explicitly defines negative film element, contrasting direct ordinary positive viewing。frame是一帧、duplicate副本、composite合成均不说明这里特定反像元素；其他候选不符合该介质名称。
light-sensitive coated layer on base直接定义emulsion乳剂层。splice为接片，frame为单帧，negative是整个元素而不是其感光层；其他词不指该涂层。
condition worsened直接定义deteriorated劣化。duplicate为副本、composite合成均非此恶化过去分词，其他候选词性不合且不表状态变坏。
point of comparison explicitly reference参照，且明说rather than newly copied film排除duplicate。conjecture为推测非实存比较源，frame单帧不能指这张服装照在论证中的参照功能。
intensity colour定义saturation饱和度。contrast后定义明暗差，exposure为拍摄入光量、uniformity均一性都不是颜色强度指标。
difference lighter darker定义contrast对比度。saturation色强、exposure拍摄受光、uniformity均匀均不等于明暗差异；其他候选非该控制参数。
amount light reaching film shooting定义exposure曝光。saturation和contrast是影像属性而不是此次定义的受光量，reference参照、conjecture推测均非拍摄参数。
regions where evidence different rather identical everywhere定义selectively有选择地。其余候选无此方式副词，uniformity为名词不能代替区域差别处理的副词。
join between pieces film定义splice接片。frame单帧不是两片接点，emulsion涂层、negative元素、composite合成并不具体指物理拼接处。
inference beyond securely established说明conjecture推测。reference为证据参照、uniformity均一、exposure曝光、contrast对比均不指证据不足时推断的认识性质。

findings: The software terms are explicitly imagined; no real license’s obligations are invented or generalised.

Redistribution and modification are separate actions; attribution does not transfer authorship of every change, and compatible concerns jointly satisfiable conditions.
Unused fork, inherited, proprietary, repository and warranty were checked against all slots; no generic rule that every public library requires disclosure is asserted.

questionAudits.finding: component needed another to work定义dependency依赖项。repository是代码存储库，fork为分支副本，license许可、warranty保证均不是此所需组件角色。
through intermediate rather direct selection定义transitive传递性的。inherited泛继承、proprietary专有均不精确表达经中间依赖关系，compatible为可兼容、explicitly为副词也不合。
grant permissions with conditions定义license许可。warranty为保证不等于授权，repository存储地点、fork副本不命名允许使用的条款文书。
duties accompanied permission直接定义obligations义务。attribution是可能的一项署名要求而非此处复数义务总称，modification修改、redistribution再分发是行为非责任总类。
passing copies other people定义redistribution再分发。modification改代码不等于给人副本，fork分支副本、dependency依赖不命名传递复制品的动作。
change to code直接定义modification修改。redistribution复制分发可不改，attribution署名不等于改变源代码，fork副本可能含或不含修改，其他项不直接等于此定义。
credit identifying original contributors直接定义attribution署名。warranty为保证、license授权总条款、repository仓库均不指贡献者致谢身份；其他候选不合。
able complied with together定义compatible兼容。proprietary专有不表示两组条件能否同履，inherited继承、transitive传递不定义相容，其他词词性或意思不符。
making specified information available recipients直接定义disclose披露。fork作动词建立分叉不表示公开指定信息；其他候选无该会使信息可获得的原形动词。
directly unambiguously rather implied直接定义explicitly明确地。其余候选没有此表达显性方式副词，inherited等分词不能直接修饰stated表清楚说明。
